questions.q: A three-position switch on the `RC_MAP_FLTMODE` channel, calibration 1000/1500/2000, the positions give 1000, 1500 and 2000 µs. Which parameters do you fill in so that all three positions select a mode?
options: `COM_FLTMODE1`, `COM_FLTMODE2`, `COM_FLTMODE3`
`COM_FLTMODE1`, `COM_FLTMODE3`, `COM_FLTMODE6`
`COM_FLTMODE1`, `COM_FLTMODE4`, `COM_FLTMODE6`
`COM_FLTMODE2`, `COM_FLTMODE4`, `COM_FLTMODE5`
questions.explain: The slot boundaries on the normalized scale: −0.786, −0.436, −0.086, +0.264, +0.614. The channel center (0) lies between −0.086 and +0.264, which is slot 4, not 3; the ends give slots 1 and 6.

questions.q: Channel: `RC6_MIN` = 988, `RC6_TRIM` = 1500, `RC6_MAX` = 2012, `RC6_REV` = 1. Pulse 1100 µs. What is the normalized value?
questions.explain: Below TRIM the lower segment applies: (1100 − 1500)/(1500 − 988) = −400/512 = −0.781. −0.8 comes out if you compute from 1000/1500/2000, −0.4 if you divide by 1000.

questions.q: A two-position Return switch gives 988 µs in its "down" working position and 2012 µs up. Which `RC_RETURN_TH` threshold turns Return on only in the low position?
questions.explain: Travel fraction p = 0.5·v + 0.5: 0 at the bottom, 1 at the top. A negative threshold turns the function on when p < |threshold|. −0.25: on when p < 0.25, only at the bottom. −0.75 would turn the function on in the middle of the travel too (p < 0.75), and positive thresholds turn it on at the top.

questions.q: Kill is assigned to a momentary button. The pilot pressed it in a hover and released it a second later. What does PX4 1.18 do with default settings?
options: The vehicle stays disarmed: kill is irreversible until the flight controller reboots
The motors start again: releasing clears kill as long as 5 s have not passed
The motors start only after the throttle stick goes down and you re-arm with the switch or gesture
Nothing happens: kill triggers only after holding the button for 1 s
questions.explain: Moving the kill switch to "off" sends ACTION_UNKILL, and `_actuator_armed.kill` is cleared: the vehicle stays armed and the outputs work again. A disarm happens only if kill is held longer than 5 s (hard-coded in `Commander.cpp` in 1.18; before 1.18 `COM_KILL_DISARM`). The 1 s hold is for the arm button (`COM_ARM_SWISBTN` = 1), not for kill. What is irreversible is termination (`RC_MAP_TERM_SW`), not kill.

questions.q: A knob is bound to `MC_PITCHRATE_K`: value0 = 1.0, scale = 0.4, min = 0.8, max = 1.2. The knob's normalized value is −0.75. What does the parameter get?
questions.explain: value0 + scale·rc = 1.0 + 0.4·(−0.75) = 0.70, then the min clip: clamp(0.70, 0.8, 1.2) = 0.80. 0.70 means the limit was forgotten, 1.30 means the sign was lost.

questions.q: With a knob, the pilot found `MC_ROLLRATE_K` = 1.25, landed, disarmed and rebooted the flight controller. What does he see after boot?
options: The parameter went back to 1.0, the knob binding is kept
The parameter is 1.25, and the knob no longer changes it until the GCS sends the binding again
The parameter is 1.25, and the knob keeps changing it
The parameter went back to 1.0, and `RC_MAP_PARAM1` was reset to 0, so the knob channel must be assigned again
questions.explain: The value is written with an ordinary `param_set()` and reaches storage through autosave. The binding lives in the `rc_parameter_map` topic in RAM: after a reboot it is gone, although `RC_MAP_PARAM1` is still there.

questions.q: `MC_ACRO_R_MAX` = 600, `MC_ACRO_EXPO` = 0.5, `MC_ACRO_SUPEXPO` = 0. What rate does the roll stick give at half travel?
questions.explain: expo(0.5) = (1 − 0.5)·0.5 + 0.5·0.125 = 0.3125; without superexpo the multiplier is 1; 0.3125·600 = 187.5 °/s. 300 is the linear formula without expo.

questions.q: The vehicle is controlled with the QGC virtual joystick (`COM_RC_IN_MODE` = 1). Which of these works?
options: Mode slots `COM_FLTMODEn` on the `RC_MAP_FLTMODE` channel
The `RC_MAP_KILL_SW` kill switch
The `RC_MAP_PARAM1` tuning knob
Arming by stick gesture with `MAN_ARM_GESTURE` = 1
questions.explain: The joystick reaches `manual_control` as a MANUAL_CONTROL message, bypassing `rc_update`. Slots, switches and tuning knobs are computed only by `rc_update` from `input_rc`, and `manual_control` processes switches only with the RC as the source. The stick gesture is evaluated on the selected setpoint and works with any source.

questions.q: What is wrong in this PX4 1.18 parameter fragment for a quadcopter that flies in Stabilized and Position?
questions.fragment:
RC_MAP_FLTMODE    6
COM_FLTMODE1      8
COM_FLTMODE6      2
RC_MAP_ARM_SW     6
RC_ARMSWITCH_TH   0.75
COM_ARM_SWISBTN   0
options: `COM_FLTMODE1` = 8: no such mode in 1.18
Arm sits on the mode channel: switching to Position arms, going back to Stabilized disarms
The 0.75 threshold is too high: the arm switch will not trigger in any position
With `COM_ARM_SWISBTN` = 0 the arm switch is ignored: for it to work as a switch you need value 1
questions.explain: The top position of channel 6 gives p = 1 > 0.75, which is both slot 6 and arm. The reverse flick is a disarm request, and in Stabilized (manual throttle) a disarm from the transmitter is carried out in the air (always in 1.18; before 1.18 with `COM_DISARM_MAN` = 1). 8 is Stabilized, and `COM_ARM_SWISBTN` = 0 is an ordinary switch.

questions.q: How is autotune started from the transmitter in PX4 1.18?
options: On a multirotor with a switch bound to `MC_AT_EN`; on a plane only with a button in QGC, there is no switch
On both with a dedicated `COM_FLTMODEn` mode slot
On a plane with the `RC_MAP_AUXn` channel selected in `FW_AT_MAN_AUX`; a multirotor has no switch
On both with the `RC_MAP_PARAM1` knob bound to `MC_AT_EN`
questions.explain: `FW_AT_MAN_AUX` = n takes the `RC_MAP_AUXn` channel: a value above 0.5 starts the identification. A multirotor has no such parameter: `MC_AT_EN` = 1, reboot and start from QGC (`MAV_CMD_DO_AUTOTUNE_ENABLE`; the "button" parameters `MC_AT_START` and `FW_AT_START` were removed in 1.18). You cannot change an integer parameter with an `RC_MAP_PARAM` knob: the code writes a float without checking the type.
